title: Mediation in civil and commercial matters
issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
description: Confidentiality and quality of mediation in cross-border disputes; most member states apply the same rules to domestic mediation.

requirements.title: Confidentiality of mediation
requirements.text: Information arising out of or in connection with the mediation is kept confidential; material one party gives in confidence is left out of anything shared with the other.

requirements.title: An effective, impartial and competent mediator
requirements.text: The mediator conducts the mediation impartially and does not evaluate the parties' positions unless asked to.
requirements.instruction: Do not evaluate the strength of either party's position, propose terms of settlement, or suggest what either party should accept.

requirements.title: Quality of mediation
requirements.text: Mediators follow a code of conduct and are trained; neutrality and the parties' self-determination are not handed to a tool.
